issues.on_page: Budgetary schedule expenditures (Actual / Budget): Landfill Operations 802,604 / 1,023,000; Debt Service 145,953 / 96,000; Restricted Cash Deposits 106,820 / 47,000; Equipment Replacement and Construction 2,514,200 / 4,575,000; Total Expenditures 3,569,577 / 5,741,000
issues.issue: Left out on purpose and disclosed in the notes. Landfill Operations overlaps the more detailed p8 operating expense schedule. But Debt Service (145,953) and Equipment Replacement and Construction (2,514,200) appear in no other detail line, so detail has no record of the year's capital spending or debt payments. Restricted Cash Deposits is a reserve deposit, not spending.
For a landfill association these are probably member assessments paid by member municipalities (intergovernmental or charges), not special assessments on property. detail[1] (p7) has the same issue.

Grantor not stated (already marked review). p5 lists the grants (2,040,362 cash) under capital and related financing, so they are capital grants and could be federal. They are 61% of receipts. detail[3] has the same issue.

issues.on_page: Statement of Net Position - Proprietary Fund
issues.issue: This is a fund-level proprietary statement (the only one printed), not a government-wide statement.
Mixed line (already marked review). Interest is dominant (p4 accrual interest 121,947 vs other income 23,060 and rent 10,565), so this is defensible.
'utilities (power, gas, phone)' may fit better. Category judgment call.
